The grey text on the home page is now `#3d4650`. I did not approve the new baselines, so the visual test for the home page still shows as changed.

I added a rule in `site/css/pages.css`: `.page-home { --color-muted: #3d4650; }`. That changes the shared muted colour only on the home page, so the other five pages are unaffected. On the home page it covers the hero subtitle, the stat labels, the text inside the cards, and the newsletter note.

I ran the visual tests. The other five pages (10 snapshots) are unchanged. `home__desktop` and `home__phone` differ from their baselines by 0.17% and 0.38% of pixels. The report attributes this to 16 restyled elements with an identical DOM, which is the colour change.

Baseline approval is your call. If the change looks right, run `npx testivai approve home__desktop` and `npx testivai approve home__phone`, or tell me to approve them. I haven't run the functional tests, since only a colour changed.

STATUS: DONE
